description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of certificate of Excemption to overseas Realty (Ceylon) PLC
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It involves the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution, which constitutes a regulatory matter. The content focuses on legal authority, statutory instruments, and regulatory compliance rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
